description: Ruling 2026-08-14 (sequence/org-settings-design.md iteration 3): one audit substrate projected three ways, never three logs. The substrate exists — audit_log (migration 0006, src/lib/audit.ts). (1) Instrument the org-level writers that do not yet record: invite mint/claim/revoke, member removal (with what was revoked), token create/revoke, org default changes, ownership transfer — some of these writers are being built by MRQ-207 and the governance ticket in parallel; instrument what exists on main and leave a named seam the parallel tickets call. (2) Org admin lens: reverse-chron log of admin actions (design: prototype v1.15 #org/activity) — steady-state home is an org-settings tab (MRQ-207 shell; standalone route if 207 unmerged, noted in PR). (3) Person lens: the person record activity feed merges audit rows touching that person with the existing annotations/history. (4) Submission lens: a timeline on the submission record — submitted, routed, reviewed, decided, reversed, re-accepted, mail sent — each with author and timestamp; extend the existing ContentHistory/history machinery rather than inventing parallel storage. Server-side pagination; R7 budgets; tests per lens.
title: Activity: one append-only log, three lenses (org admin, person, submission)
